title: Final Image Position
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the position of the final image as -100 cm.

title: Image Height Ratio
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately determine the ratio of the final image height to the object height as -2.

title: Use of Lens Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the lens formula for both lenses to find image positions.

title: Magnification Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the magnification for both lenses and combine them.

title: Ray Diagram Quality
description: Optional Criteria: The ray diagram should clearly show the necessary rays for locating the final image.

title: Sign Convention
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes in the calculations of image positions and magnifications.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all distances are consistently expressed in centimeters.
